newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean bids drop as futures soar.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean bids drop as futures soar.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean basis offers declined Tuesday in reaction to steep gains in CBOT soybean futures, traders said.
South Korea's state-run Agricultural and Fishery Marketing Corp was scheduled to tender July 15 for 40,000 tonnes of soybeans for July 26-September 15 shipment if from the U.S. Gulf.
Corn values were mostly steady. Two Taiwanese groups were scheduled to tender overnight for a total of nearly 168,000 tonnes of U.S. corn for September to November positions.
Wheat basis offers were mostly steady. The winter wheat harvest was under way, but dealers said much of the wheat was being stored by farmers rather than sold into market channels.
"We will see some of it (wheat) flow in late July or early August," one wheat dealer said, noting that storage space is running out.
